tasks.description: Upgrade PhotoAlbum solution (PhotoAlbum and PhotoAlbum.Tests) from .NET 9.0 to .NET 10.0
tasks.reason: .NET 9.0 is a Standard Term Support (STS) release that reached end of support in May 2026 and is now EOL. Upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS restores long-term support, provides access to the latest runtime improvements, and ensures compatibility with current Azure SDK and NuGet packages.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade both projects in the PhotoAlbum solution from net9.0 to net10.0. This includes updating the TargetFramework in PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj and PhotoAlbum.Tests/PhotoAlbum.Tests.csproj, upgrading all NuGet package references (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing, SixLabors.ImageSharp, and test SDK packages) to versions compatible with .NET 10, and resolving any API breaking changes or deprecations introduced between .NET 9 and .NET 10.
